title: Users table
description: Workspace members table for a content-manager tenant on TanStack Table v9: flat and borderless, a member cell with avatar, name and email, role sorted by privilege, a status badge (Active needle, Invited hollow, Suspended heartwood) and time columns that sort by timestamp while showing words. A FilterBar with search, Role and Status sits above it.

anatomy.description: The shared FilterBar: a search Input (name or email), Role and Status Selects with counts as hints, and Clear all while a filter is active.
Semantic table with sortable headers (aria-sort) pinned at top: 4rem beneath the bar; hover wash on rows; no rules drawn.
Blobatar on a bark palette, the name in needle-950 over the email in bark-500.
Active: needle-200 wash. Invited: hollow dashed bark badge, nothing has happened yet. Suspended: heartwood-200 wash, the attention colour, because it needs acting on.

usage: Controlled or uncontrolled: pass filters + onFiltersChange to own the state (the users page keeps query, role and status in zod-validated search params); omit both and the table keeps it internally. The table never touches the router.

A reference composition, not a reusable primitive: copy the patterns (FilterBar above a flat sortable table, timestamp-backed relative time, status badges on the ramps' meanings) rather than the component.
Role sorts by privilege (Owner first), never alphabetically; Last active sorts by timestamp with never-active invitees last.
Only Suspended may be red: heartwood is the identity's attention colour and MUST mean something needs acting on.
Sticky toolbar height (filter-bar, 4rem) and header top offset (users-table) are coupled: change one, change both.
Table chrome is duplicated from leads-table on purpose; a shared Table primitive is the promotion waiting on a third consumer.
